title: Jonah and the Deadline
author: B. M. Halloran
blurb: Vesper Thornbury, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, has spent fifteen years following rules that keep getting rewritten. But when a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must burn the network that did the training before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
